title: Gray encounter in Catskills cabin with military and CIA observers

tellings.quote: and he sees all these military and intelligence people standing around.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber is said to have had an encounter with a gray, a small grey-skinned being, at his cabin in the Catskill mountains of New York in the 1980s, and to have seen "all these military and intelligence people standing around", including the CIA, watching. The philosopher Jason Jorjani relays this on Michels' show in 2025 from Strieber's own account, crediting his book Communion. If true, it would mean the government was present at, and perhaps behind, such encounters.
